text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HAARETZ
- Israel informed Jordanian Waqf official about intention to open second entrance in archaeological tunnel a week in advance
- Criminal charges filed against cabinet minister Rafael Eitan
- Qatar angry over cancellation of Israeli natural gas deal
- Earthquake over six on Richter scale rocks the region
JERUSALEM POST
- Jordan-Israel relations in state of deterioration
- Government allows Waqf to open Solomon's Stables for Moslem worshippers
- Mordechai invites Assad to visit
- Mordechai: Palestinian Authority must coordinate on infrastructure changes in Hebron
- Little headway in Hebron talks as new subcommittees are formed
- Government plans second offering of Bezeq
MAARIV
- Terrorist cell captured on its way to Tel Aviv
- Sarah Netanyahu's former husband vows to publish book despite pressure
- Hussein to Netanyahu: We are all on the verge of a great abyss
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- President Weizman invited to official visit in Jordan
- New appointments in Mossad intelligence agency
- Recommendation to bust Bezeq's monopoly on toll calls
